settings.overviewDescription: Defaults, activity tracking and the giveaway bot for every giveaway in this server.

descriptions.winnerCount: Used when a quick giveaway is started without a winners count.
descriptions.duration: Used when a quick giveaway is started without a duration, for example 1d 12h.
descriptions.collectSeconds: Used when a quick giveaway is started without a claiming timeout. At least one hour.
descriptions.accentColor: Colour of the built-in giveaway layout, for example #b0ff00.
descriptions.logChannel: Every giveaway created, ended, rerolled or cancelled is logged here, along with recurring giveaways that need attention.
descriptions.dmWinners: Send each winner a direct message as well as the channel ping.
descriptions.trackActivity: Count messages and voice time so giveaways can require them. Only counts from the moment this is switched on.
descriptions.messageChannels: Only messages in these channels or categories count. Leave empty to count every channel.
descriptions.voiceChannels: Only time in these voice channels or categories counts. Leave empty to count every channel except the AFK channel.
descriptions.voiceCountMuted: Whether time spent muted counts as voice time.
descriptions.voiceCountDeafened: Whether time spent deafened counts as voice time.
descriptions.voiceMinMembers: How many people, bots excluded, must be in the channel for the time to count. 1 counts people who are alone.
descriptions.botToken: Run giveaways as your own bot instead of mine. Paste its token from the Discord Developer Portal, then invite that bot to this server.
descriptions.presenceType: What the bot appears to be doing.
descriptions.presenceText: The text shown after the activity type.
descriptions.presenceEmoji: Emoji shown beside a Custom status.
descriptions.profileNick: The nickname the bot uses in this server.
descriptions.profileAvatar: Server-specific avatar. Paste a Discord image link.
descriptions.profileBanner: Server-specific banner. Paste a Discord image link.
descriptions.profileBio: Short bio on the bot profile in this server. Discord does not report it back, so this box always looks empty even once set.

reasons.customBotOnly: Set a custom bot token first.

settings.profileWriteFailed: I could not update the profile. Check my permissions and try again.
settings.presenceEmojiNotFound: No emoji named {{name}} in this server.

templates.title: Giveaway Templates
templates.overview: Reusable giveaways you can start with {{command}}, or let run on a schedule.
templates.currencyAdvert: Winning currency needs Ayako Economy in this server. [Invite it]({{invite}}) to pay winners in your server currency.

enforcement.onEnd: Keep the entry but skip the member at the draw

descriptions.name: The name you pick in {{command}}. Each name can be used once per server.
descriptions.description: What is being given away. Required before the template can start.
descriptions.prize: Shown to every winner when they claim, for example: Steam key for Hades.
descriptions.channel: Where the giveaway is posted. Required for recurring giveaways.
descriptions.host: Shown as the host. Defaults to whoever starts the giveaway.
descriptions.duration: How long each giveaway runs. Uses the server default when empty.
descriptions.winnerCount: How many winners to draw. Uses the server default when empty.
descriptions.collectSeconds: How long winners have to claim. At least one hour.
descriptions.failReroll: Draw a new winner for everyone who does not claim in time.
descriptions.requiredRoles: Members need at least one of these roles to win.
descriptions.excludedRoles: Members with any of these roles can never win.
descriptions.enforcement: What happens when a member enters without meeting every requirement.
descriptions.minAccountSeconds: How old the Discord account must be.
descriptions.minTenureSeconds: How long the member must have been in this server.
descriptions.minMessages: Tracked messages the member must have sent. Needs activity tracking.
descriptions.minMessagesSince: Messages the member must send after the giveaway starts. Needs activity tracking.
descriptions.minVoiceSeconds: Tracked voice time the member must have. Needs activity tracking.
descriptions.bonusRoles: Members with any of these roles get extra entries.
descriptions.bonusExtra: How many extra entries a bonus role gives. 1 means double entries.
descriptions.personalPrizes: Every winner gets their own prize, such as a game key. Starting the giveaway asks for one prize per winner.
descriptions.currency: Server currency paid to each winner when they claim.
descriptions.winnerRoles: Roles given to each winner when they claim.
descriptions.design: A saved embed or Components V2 design used instead of the built-in layout. The giveaway buttons are added below it. Placeholders: {{list}}
descriptions.banner: Image shown across the built-in layout, as an http or https link.
descriptions.thumbnail: Small image beside the title of the built-in layout, as an http or https link.
descriptions.accentColor: Colour of the built-in layout, for example #b0ff00.
descriptions.repeatSeconds: Start this giveaway again on a fixed rhythm, for example 7d. At least one hour.
descriptions.nextRun: How long until the next run. Later runs follow the rhythm from there.

guide.title: Giveaway Setup
guide.intro: Set the defaults once and every /giveaway quick gets shorter.
guide.advertText: Save reusable and recurring giveaways as templates.
